title: Virginia Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Virginia Small Claims Court (2026): $5,000 Limit & Rules
rank_math_description: Virginia small claims in 2026: $5,000 limit (HB 364 did not pass), no lawyers, trial on the first return date, defendant removal and 10-day appeals.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> Warrant in Debt or Detinue -> right GDC -> fee (use vacourts fee calculator) -> pick trial date (5+ days after service) -> service -> trial on first return date -> 10-day appeal + 30-day bond -> interrogatories / garnishment / lien
Box: removal right of the defendant (16.1-122.4(B))
